source.citation: U. Ghia, K. N. Ghia and C. T. Shin, High-Re solutions for incompressible flow using the Navier-Stokes equations and a multigrid method, Journal of Computational Physics 48(3), 387-411 (1982), Table I.
source.note: u along the vertical line through the cavity centre, non-dimensionalised by the lid speed. The cavity is the unit square and the lid speed is 1, so the tabulated values are used as they stand.

agreement.note: A discretisation of this flow that resolves the primary vortex agrees with the table to within a few thousandths; 0.02 RMS is loose enough to pass a coarse but honest mesh and tight enough to fail a wrong one.
